headline: MacroFactor Workouts UI Revamp: Exercise Carousel, Custom Gym Keypad with RIR Strip & Anatomical Heatmap Celebration

sections.title: Top Exercise Switcher Carousel
items: Replaced long vertical scrolling with MacroFactor's top horizontal exercise switcher strip.
Browse exercises with movement thumbnails, titles, and completed set badges (e.g. 4/4 with green checkmark).
1-tap to switch between exercises with dedicated '+' tile at the end to add exercises on the fly.
Menu toggle between Carousel (Focused) mode and All Exercises (List) mode.

sections.title: MacroFactor Set Grid & Mini Colored RIR Badges
items: Crisp set table: Set | Previous ↔ | Lb | Reps | Checkbox.
High-contrast active focus borders around the active weight or reps input box.
Mini colored circular RIR badges directly on the corner of the Reps box (0 red, 1 coral, 2 orange, 3 yellow, 4 mint, 5 green, 6+ blue).
Square completion checkboxes fill with haptic feedback upon logging.

sections.title: Docked Custom Gym Keypad
items: Docked custom gym keypad eliminates modal stepper sheets.
Top colored RIR rating strip (0 to 6+): 1-tap immediately stamps set RIR.
10-key numeric pad with first-digit overwrite for fast load and rep adjustments.
Prominent black checkmark button (✓) commits set, starts rest timer, and auto-focuses the next set or exercise.

sections.title: Workout Complete Anatomical Heatmap Celebration
items: Front & back anatomical humanoid figures in SwiftUI Canvas with worked muscles illuminated in MacroFactor royal blue (#2F7CF6).
PR milestone trophy cards for Volume Records, Reps Records, and Est. 1RM Records.
Summary metrics: total working volume, completed sets, elapsed duration, and live heart rate / calories.
MacroFactor 'Update Workout Plan' default switch to save modifications to your program routine template.

sections.title: Preserved Total Factor Advantages
items: Preserved Progression Wand (🪄) with overload rationale and dynamic rep range expansion.
Preserved live Apple Watch heart rate corner badge (❤️ 142 BPM).
Preserved Rest Timer Live Activity & Dynamic Island with Apple Watch wrist haptics.
Preserved pre-workout fasted fuel warnings, unilateral L/R logging, equipment swaps, and plate calculator.

headline: Siri AI & Apple Intelligence Spoken Food Logging, On-Device Apple Vision Plate Classification & Semantic Embeddings

sections.title: Siri AI & Apple Intelligence Spoken Food Logging
items: Hands-free conversational food logging: speak to Siri from iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, or CarPlay ("Hey Siri, log 3 scrambled eggs and 2 slices toast in Total Factor").
Powered by on-device Apple Intelligence and Siri App Intents (LogFoodIntent) with zero dependence on Google Gemini or external cloud APIs.
Resolves foods and exact gram portions instantly via the bundled ~8,156-item USDA database and responds with calories and protein.
Immediate widget update reflecting new calories and protein in under 50ms without opening the app.

sections.title: Siri Quick Calorie & Macro Logging
items: 1-sentence quick calorie logging: "Hey Siri, log 450 calories in Total Factor".
Immediately enqueues entry, increments daily targets, and syncs to Apple Health.

sections.title: On-Device Apple Vision Plate Classifier
items: 100% offline meal photo recognition using Apple's Vision framework (VNClassifyImageRequest) running locally on the Neural Engine in <50ms.
Classifies common foods (grilled chicken, eggs, steak, salmon, pizza, burgers, salad, pasta, rice, oatmeal, etc.) without cloud AI.
Added "Identify Plate On-Device (Apple Vision AI)" button in DescribeMealView: snap or select a photo to generate USDA meal entries without a Gemini key.

sections.title: Apple NaturalLanguage Semantic Vector Matching
items: Neural Engine word embeddings (NLEmbedding) map colloquial slang and synonyms (e.g., "poultry" → chicken, "flapjack" → pancake, "espresso" → coffee) to USDA whole foods.

sections.title: Instant Background & Lock Screen Widget Sync
items: PendingQuickAction carries complete macro payloads (calories, protein, carbs, fat, grams, meal tag) directly to SwiftData and HealthKit upon app opening.

sections.title: SideStore IPA Packaging Cleanliness
items: Resolved "The app's Info.plist could not be found" error in SideStore.
Automatically strips test bundles (.xctest) and debug symbol folders (.dSYM) from PlugIns before packaging so SideStore's AltSign parser validates cleanly.
Removes companion watchOS targets from the standalone sideload archive for seamless personal-certificate sideloading.

headline: Multi-Add Food Logging, Native Intermittent Fasting, Flexible Rolling Splits, Program Import/Export & Progress Photos Overhaul

sections.title: Multi-Add Food Logging ("Multi-Select Staging Tray")
items: Each search row features a dedicated "+" button that stages foods directly into a persistent bottom dock with haptic feedback without closing search.
Real-time staging dock displays selected food count, total calories, and protein (e.g., "3 Items Staged • 520 kcal • 42g protein").
Full Review Staged Meal sheet to adjust serving sizes, multiplier steppers (0.25×–20×), or remove items before committing.
1-tap "Log All (N)" commits all staged items into SwiftData and Apple Health in a single transaction.

sections.title: Native Intermittent Fasting (IF) Engine
items: Supported protocols: 16:8 LeanGains (Standard), 18:6 Deep Fast, 20:4 Warrior Diet, OMAD (23:1), 14:10 Moderate, and Circadian (13:11).
Today Dashboard Intermittent Fasting card displays active fast elapsed time, target countdown, and eating window progress.
Smart automatic calculation starting from yesterday"s last logged food timestamp, plus 1-tap "Start Fast" / "End Fast" override controls.
Toggle and protocol selector in Settings → Intermittent Fasting.

sections.title: Flexible Rolling Split Workouts ("Work Out Whatever Days You Want")
items: Choose between Fixed Weekdays and Rolling Split (Any Day / Flexible) scheduling modes in Program Settings.
In Rolling Split mode, workouts are never locked to calendar days; routines cycle automatically (1 → 2 → 3 → 4) whenever you train.
Today Dashboard dynamically displays "Next Up: [Workout Name]" and advances to the next routine upon workout completion.
Added "Switch Workout" menu on Today"s training card to start any routine in your active program at any time with 1 tap.
Train Hub displays a bright green "NEXT UP" badge on the next scheduled routine.

sections.title: Complete Program Import & Export Engine
items: Export complete programs to ".totalfactorprogram" files via the iOS Share Sheet (AirDrop, Messages, Files) or copy JSON to clipboard.
Import Program File and Import from Clipboard in Program Builder and Train Hub.
Automatically matches routine movements against the 118 bundled exercise library and auto-creates custom exercises for new movements.

sections.title: Overhauled Progress Photos & Mirror Camera Capture
items: Fixed empty state bug where having 1 photo rendered ContentUnavailableView, making photos feel lost.
Single-photo showcase prominently displays your photo with date and weight badge.
Comparison mode for 2+ photos with Before & After photo picker menus, days-apart, and weight delta badges.
Supports both Split Slider and Side-by-Side comparison modes.
In-app "Take Photo" mirror camera capture alongside Photos library picker.
Thumbnail history gallery reel with tap-to-inspect and delete photo with confirmation.
Downsamples photos to clean 1600px JPEG to keep SQLite storage fast and lean.

sections.title: MacroFactor Visual Polish & Adaptive Expenditure (TDEE)
items: Re-branded "Metabolism" card to "Adaptive Expenditure (TDEE)" with daily energy burn indicators and confidence pills.
Added Energy Balance (Intake vs. TDEE) card displaying net daily deficit or surplus with color-coded badges.
Clarified synergy between workout energy burn and dynamic TDEE adaptations.

sections.title: AI Food Logging & Precision Prompt Overhaul
items: Explicitly instructed Gemini schema that all calories and macros must represent the TOTAL portion weight in grams.
Multimodal coupling: synthesizes photo visual portions with user text notes for hidden ingredients and cooking oils.
Enriches Gemini meals with verified offline USDA micronutrients (potassium, iron, zinc, magnesium).
Added 20+ common everyday food aliases to offline parser (almond milk, steak, salmon, avocado, blueberries).

sections.title: Fixed In-App Update Log Decoding
items: Repaired corrupted nested JSON in releases 1–5, restoring full update history under Settings → What's New & Update Log.

headline: Un-Cramped Workout UI, Proactive Reminders, Apple Fitness Workouts Sync & Live Heart Rate Corner Badge

sections.title: Un-Cramped Workout UI & In-Session Custom Exercises
items: Spacious 44pt+ touch targets on set rows and weight/rep buttons separating load and reps (175 lb × 10 @2) for easy tapping with gym fingers.
Removed repetitive placeholder coaching text from cards; surfaces only real progression overload notes.
Added '+ Custom Exercise' button directly inside the in-workout Add Exercise sheet.

sections.title: Proactive Reminders & Notifications
items: Configurable morning weigh-in reminder to maintain accurate weight trends before breakfast.
Customizable meal logging reminders for lunch, dinner, and evening missed food checks.
Pre-workout fueling and energy alerts on scheduled training days.

sections.title: Apple Watch Vibration & Rest Timer Fix
items: Fixed rest timer notification cancellation bug so timers trigger reliable wrist haptic vibrations on Apple Watch when iPhone is locked (no companion app needed).
Time-sensitive alert delivery breaking through lock screens and Focus modes.

sections.title: Live Heart Rate Badge & Apple Fitness Workouts Sync
items: Prominent Live Heart Rate corner badge in Active Workout navigation bar streaming continuously from Apple Watch or HealthKit.
Syncs all external Apple Fitness workouts (Soccer, Running, Cycling, Swimming, HIIT) to Today's Dashboard and Food Timeline.

sections.title: Expanded Library (+22 New Exercises)
items: Added 22 missing strength, hypertrophy, and conditioning staples including Incline Cable Fly, Close-Grip Bench Press, Cable Y-Raise, Bulgarian Split Squats, Landmine Press/Row, Running, Soccer, Cycling, and Swimming.

headline: MacroFactor Workouts Complete Feature Suite: Progression Wand, Bilateral Logging, In-Workout Swapping & Volume Landmarks

sections.title: Smart Progression Wand & Dynamic Rep Expansion
items: Interactive Progression Wand (🪄) on exercise cards explaining why targets changed with 🔵 Blue, 🟡 Yellow, and 🔴 Orange diagnostics.
Dynamic Rep Range Expansion: Automatically detects when equipment jumps are >= 12.5% and widens rep ceilings (+3 reps) to build capacity before adding weight.

sections.title: Bilateral Tracking & Persistent Setup Notes
items: Independent Left and Right logging (L: 35 lb x 10, R: 35 lb x 9) with 1-tap Bilateral/Unilateral toggle and Copy Left to Right shortcut.
Persistent machine & rack setup notes (seat height, pin settings, cable notches) pinned to exercises that automatically carry forward across workouts.

sections.title: In-Workout Swapping & Routine Commit
items: 1-Tap Exercise Swapping: Find biomechanically matched replacements in the same movement pattern and muscle group when equipment is occupied.
Workout Change Log on finish: Prompts to commit session tweaks (added sets, swaps) back to your saved program routine or keep for today only.

sections.title: Hypertrophy Landmarks & Bodyweight Modes
items: Weekly Hypertrophy Volume Landmarks card in Train Hub tracking trailing 7-day hard sets against MV (<8), MEV (8-11), MAV (12-20), and MRV (21+).
Bodyweight training support with automatic morning weigh-in sync for weighted dips/pull-ups (+25 lb) and assisted counterweights (-40 lb).
Added Myo-rep (M) set type with Apple Watch wrist companion and history sync.

headline: Apple Health & Fitness UI Redesign, Un-Cramped Layouts & SideStore Wireless Auto-Signing

sections.title: Apple Health & Apple Fitness Design
items: Redesigned Total Factor with the spacious, un-cramped visual language of Apple Health and Apple Fitness, using native grouped background cards, generous padding, and floating frosted-glass toolbars.
Adopted bold San Francisco Rounded metric typography (.design: .rounded) and Apple's vibrant health palette: Flame Orange, Coral Pink, Electric Cyan, Gold, Purple, and Teal.
Transformed Today Dashboard with an Apple Fitness hero calorie card, side-by-side Trend & Metabolism cards, a clean 2x2 telemetry grid, and sleek Apple Fitness segmented macro bars.
Refined Food Diary and Progress Hub with clean line-item rows, micro-colored macro chips, and smart Goal Target Date projections.

sections.title: SideStore Wireless Auto-Signing Pipeline
items: Added Scripts/build_ipa.sh to compile and package TotalFactor.ipa directly into your iCloud Drive folder with all embedded Watch and Widget extensions.
Import TotalFactor.ipa into SideStore on your iPhone for perpetual, wireless background app re-signing every 3–5 days over Wi-Fi without needing a Mac.

headline: 8,156-Food Offline USDA Catalog, Voice & Photo Meal Logging, Apple Watch Companion & Full Spec Sweep

sections.title: Full 8,156-Food Offline USDA Database
items: Bundled 8,156 lab-verified USDA Foundation + SR Legacy whole foods (3.75 MB) with calories, macros, fiber, sugar, sodium, household serving weights, and full micronutrients.

Built a fast inverted token + singular/plural index (OfflineUSDACatalogService) that keeps SwiftData @Query lean for 120Hz scrolling and materializes Food rows lazily only when logged, favorited, or used in a recipe.

sections.title: Voice, Natural-Language & Meal-Photo Logging
items: Added 'Describe / Voice' mode in Quick Add plus a 1-tap mic button directly in the Search bar using live on-device Speech Recognition.

Built an instant 100% offline NaturalLanguageMealParser that splits multi-item meals (e.g. '3 eggs, 80g oats, 200g greek yogurt and 1.5 tbsp peanut butter') and resolves gram portions against your history + 8,156 USDA foods.

Added optional Gemini AI (gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-pro) multimodal text + meal-photo parsing (API key stored securely in Keychain in Settings) leading into a 1-tap Multi-Item Confirmation Sheet synced to Apple Health.

sections.title: Apple Watch Companion (watchOS 10+)
items: Added native TotalFactorWatch app signed for your Personal Team using bidirectional WatchConnectivity (zero paid App Groups needed).
Includes 1-tap wrist set logging, Digital Crown weight & rep dialing, wrist haptic rest timer countdowns (3-2-1-Go), remaining macros glance, and Digital Crown wrist weigh-ins.
Runs HKWorkoutSession on Apple Watch to stay active on wrist raise and stream live BPM + display-only active kcal to an isolated banner in ActiveWorkoutView.

sections.title: Phase 2–9 Spec Sweep & Interactive Widgets
items: Exercise Library: Chronological per-exercise Session & Set History cards showing every past session's volume, top e1RM, and individual sets.
Custom Nutrient Zones: Edit or reset Floor, Target, and Ceiling values for any macro or micronutrient (including Sugar, Vitamin C, and Cholesterol) from Micronutrient Details or Settings.
Food Timeline Upgrades: 'Copy From Any Date...' calendar picker with meal filter & macro preview, optional 'Grouped by Meal' view toggle + inline MealTag picker, and Daily Notes editor.

Body & Schedule: Lean Body Mass (FFM) HealthKit sync + Swift Charts card in Progress, visual Mon–Sun schedule strip in Program Builder & Train Hub, and interactive +/-/✓ weigh-in buttons on the Home Screen Trend & Workout Widget.

headline: 120Hz Smooth Scrolling, Pre-Loaded Strong History, Offline Exercise Guides & Planet Fitness Setup

sections.title: Fixed Vertical Scroll Lag (120Hz Smooth Scrolling)
items: Eliminated View.body database & IPC stalls: TodayDashboardView, FoodTimelineView, ProgressHubView, and ActiveWorkoutView now read CoachingCoordinator.cachedOrComputeDigest in O(1) without side effects instead of running 7 SwiftData fetches, mutating ExpenditureEstimate, and reloading WidgetKit over XPC mid-scroll.
SharedSnapshotStore now skips WidgetCenter XPC reloads when widget snapshots haven't changed.
Zero-allocation row rendering: added @Transient decoded caches on Exercise, GymProfile, and Food, direct arithmetic macro getters on FoodLogEntry, and a static DateFormatter in DayKey.displayTitle.

Isolated 500ms rest-timer updates into ActiveWorkoutMiniBar and ActiveRestTimerBanner, switched active workouts to LazyVStack with memoized ActiveExerciseCardView, and cached search rankings in QuickAddFoodSheet.

sections.title: Your Workouts & Full Strong History Pre-Loaded
items: 124 sessions & 1,214 sets imported automatically from BundledStrongWorkouts.csv on launch (safe and deduplicated for existing installs), fitting personal rep-endurance curves (k) per movement and computing chronological PRs (e1RM, Heaviest Load, Rep PR, Best Volume).
Automatically cleans Strong data quirks: converts lb loads, repairs swapped 7 lb × 140 reps typos on Seated Row, and normalizes runaway 93h/238h forgotten timers.
Activated your custom 4-day Planet Fitness Split (Push, Back and Biceps, Lower, Upper) with your real exercises, sets, and rep ranges, pre-filling next-session suggested weights from your history.
Added Import CSV buttons in TrainHubView and SettingsView plus searchable full workout history in WorkoutHistoryListView.

sections.title: Offline Exercise Pictures & Step-by-Step How-To Guides
items: Bundled 182 offline Start & Finish demo photos across 96 exercises in ExerciseMedia/ and BundledExercises.json, decoded off the main thread by ExerciseImageCache.

Built interactive ExerciseGuideContentView with Animated Start ↔ Finish playback, side-by-side pose toggle, Front & Back TargetMuscleDiagramView, Planet Fitness & Machine Setup card, numbered steps, coaching cues, and common mistakes.
1-tap Guide access from TodayDashboardView, TrainHubView (WorkoutOverviewGuideSheet), ActiveWorkoutView (ExerciseGuideSheet), and ExerciseLibraryView.

sections.title: Planet Fitness Active Gym Profile
items: Configured Planet Fitness and set it as Active Gym automatically: Machines, Cables with 2.5 lb micro-stack jumps, counterbalanced 20 lb Smith Machine carriage, 5–75 lb Dumbbells in 5 lb jumps, EZ-Curl Bars, Kettlebells, Bodyweight, and Bands (excluding free Olympic barbells so unavailable barbell lifts auto-swap cleanly).
Updated GymProfileEditorView to display and edit equipment weights in lb (or kg based on your unit setting).

sections.title: Running Update Log & Easy iPhone Updates
items: Added What's New & Update Log right inside Settings (synced with UPDATES.md) plus live installed version/build display so you can always see every little tweak on your phone.

Added workspace rule (AGENTS.md) so every future update or small fix automatically logs here and bumps the build number, fixed Xcode Personal Team signing (8MF8V7WZJB) in project.yml, and added Scripts/update_iphone.sh for 1-step iPhone updates.

sections.title: Adaptive Nutrition, Smart Training & Extensions
items: 21-entity SwiftData schema with local-first storage, optional CloudKit sync, 3-step onboarding, and Apple Health sync.
Chronological Food Timeline, Floor/Target/Ceiling MacroZoneBar, 2-tap Quick Add, inline kitchen-scale calculator, recipe builder, USDA + Open Food Facts search, and Vision OCR label scanner.
EMA weight trend (alpha = 0.1), rolling 14–28d dynamic expenditure engine, macro safety floors, and program-tied carb cycling.
1-tap Active Workout Logger, Lock Screen & Dynamic Island rest timer Live Activity, effort-adjusted e1RM + personal k-curve progression, Home/Lock Screen widgets, Siri Shortcuts, and CSV exports.
